about_the_game:
Deckout is a fast-paced, strategic card game for 2–4 players where every move matters. Outsmart your opponents using bold plays, sneaky reversals, and unexpected tricks — all packed in a fun, cartoon-styled world.

🃏 Play your way to victory: Each player starts with a unique hand of cards. Use hammers to strike, shields to block, handcuffs to disable, or reverse cards to flip the flow of battle.

🎯 Win by finishing your hand or knocking others out: Empty your hand first, or eliminate all other players with clever timing and card combos.

🧠 Simple rules, deep mind games: Easy to learn, but rewards clever decisions and long-term strategy. Perfect for casual play or competitive duels.

✨ Key Features:

  • 2–4 player matches (online and offline)

  • Unique cards like Hammer, Shield, Handcuffs, and Reverse

  • Quick matches lasting under 10 minutes

  • AI boss mode for solo challenge

  • Fun, colorful 3D visuals with a lighthearted tone

Whether you’re sabotaging your friends or surviving till the last card, Deckout guarantees explosive fun every round!
